name: The St. Regis Hotel, Houston
insider_take: Houston's most elegant address where Texas hospitality meets legendary St. Regis sophistication in the heart of the Museum District.
whats_special: This is the only St. Regis property in Texas, featuring the brand's signature Butler Service and located steps from world-class museums. The hotel sits in Houston's cultural epicenter, surrounded by 19 museums within walking distance, including the Museum of Fine Arts and Contemporary Arts Museum Houston.
pro_tip: Book the St. Regis Butler Service to arrange private museum tours and reservations at Houston's top restaurants - they have insider connections throughout the city's cultural scene.
dont_miss: The hotel's Remix Lounge for craft cocktails with a Texas twist, and take advantage of being in America's most diverse city - Hermann Park and the Houston Zoo are just across the street, while Rice University's beautiful campus is a short stroll away.
pros: Iconic St. Regis butler service and luxury amenities
Prime downtown Houston location near business district
Marriott STARS Program benefits including upgrades and credits
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travel styles
